explanation: The text is an answer to the regime the coup began. It replaced the autocratic constitution of 1967 and capped twenty-one years of military dictatorship, and it resignified the role of the state in citizens’ lives with a vast apparatus of human and individual rights protection — a list that reads as an inventory of what the twenty-one years had done. Read in this direction the edge says the constitution reacted to the coup, which is what its own drafters said they were doing.
